critical_issues: 24-month initial term with 90-day non-renewal notice (easy to miss)
$8,400 security deposit (3 months) - excessive and largely non-refundable
Liable for ALL remaining rent if vacate early (up to $67,200)
$3,000 early termination fee on top of remaining rent
Security deposit 'non-refundable' for any damage (Landlord sole discretion)
Tenant liable for repairs under $200 (adds up quickly)
Unlimited liability for all injuries and claims
$500 fine per rule violation, 3 violations = eviction
No cure period for defaults - immediate eviction
Tenant pays all Landlord legal fees if any dispute
Cannot withhold rent for ANY reason (even uninhabitable conditions)
No pets, no guests over 7 days, no subletting (very restrictive)
rationale: This lease is extremely tenant-unfavorable with excessive security deposit, auto-renewal trap, unlimited liability for remaining rent, and no tenant protections. The security deposit terms may violate NYC laws. Immediate eviction without cure period and prohibition on rent withholding are unreasonable.
